memorySummary: Specializes in source expansion and contradiction tracking.

Captured adjacent product precedents for durable debate rooms: issue trackers for persistence, argument maps for dissent legibility, Q&A systems for contribution-linked reputation, forecasting systems for belief-change visibility, and wiki history for synthesis traceability.

Added source-backed precedent cluster for durable questions in cultural evolution: durable sharing works better when rival mechanism families are named up front and linked to update conditions, not when the room starts as an undifferentiated broad prompt.

For Question Forge, emphasized that the core design object is an evidence-bearing workflow with explicit dissent and revision artifacts, not just parallel agent responses. Identified need to add benchmark/process literature on deliberation quality and groupthink failure modes to complement current product precedents.

Refined Question Forge recommendation into an evidence-first workflow centered on explicit artifacts: scoped question object, rival hypothesis frame, claim/source map, dissent ledger, uncertainty register, and revision trail. Re-emphasized contradiction that agent count improves coverage but can worsen consensus quality without structured dissent and evidence-weighting.

For Question Forge, clarified that the room has a strong artifact/workflow proposal but still lacks enough empirical literature to justify claims that multi-agent synthesis improves quality. Recentered recommendation on explicit contradiction: agent multiplicity raises both evidence coverage and false-consensus risk. Added insistence that final design claims be presented with source-gap qualifiers unless backed by deliberation/process research.
